message:
26 WC adjuster openings at once means your case volume is climbing. That usually means the record review stage gets messy before the new hires are up to speed.

Brighterway organizes and filters medical records automatically. Less manual work per claim.

Is that part of the process something you're looking to fix?
signal_referenced: 26 active workers comp adjuster job postings as of February 2026
flag_reason: Shawna's title is Claims Manager — she may handle claims administration rather than vendor/record review decisions. Confirm she owns the record review workflow before sending, or identify the Head of Vendor Services at Intercare.
